description: This header file defines classes and functions related to connector management within the WPEFramework RPC namespace, including a singleton controller class and a template connector type with communication channel management.

classes.name: ConnectorController
classes.description: Singleton class managing a controller interface, allowing announcement, revocation, and retrieval of the controller object.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class managing communication channels for RPC, providing methods to acquire interfaces, access communicators, and handle operational state.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: Nested class within ConnectorType, representing a communication channel that can be initialized, unlinked, and respond to state changes.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectorController.

methods.name: Announce
methods.description: Sets and references the controller object.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Releases and clears the controller object.

methods.name: Controller
methods.description: Returns the current controller object, adding a reference if not null.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Template method to acquire an interface from a communication channel.

methods.name: Communicator
methods.description: Returns the communicator proxy for a given node ID.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Provides access to the engine proxy type.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Virtual method to handle operational state changes.
